blocks.md: **Trade** is the buying and selling of goods and services. **Internal trade** takes place inside a country (markets, shops); **external (international) trade** is between countries. Goods sold abroad are **exports**; goods bought from abroad are **imports**. A country trades because no country has all the resources, skills or climates it needs.

blocks.caption: Exports bring money into the country
blocks.alt: A chain from producer to port to foreign buyer and money returning.

blocks.title: Balance of trade
blocks.md: **Balance of trade = value of exports − value of imports.** If exports are greater, there is a **surplus** (favourable balance); if imports are greater, there is a **deficit** (unfavourable balance). Example: exports 800 billion FCFA, imports 1000 billion FCFA gives 800 − 1000 = −200 billion FCFA, a deficit.

Cameroon exports mainly **primary products**: crude oil, timber, cocoa, bananas, coffee, cotton, rubber and aluminium. It imports **manufactured goods**: machinery, vehicles, fuel products, medicines, rice, wheat and electronic goods. Selling raw materials usually earns less than selling finished goods, which is why countries try to **process** their products locally.

blocks.title: Regional groupings
blocks.md: Neighbouring countries form **economic groupings** to trade more easily, for instance by removing duties between them and using a common currency or common rules. Cameroon belongs to **CEMAC** (Central African Economic and Monetary Community) and works with other African bodies such as the **African Union**; West Africa has **ECOWAS**. Benefits: bigger markets and cooperation; difficulties: poor roads, differing rules and border delays.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- Exports go out of the country; imports come in.
- A deficit means imports exceed exports: do not call it a profit.
- Balance of trade is about goods; the balance of payments also includes services and other flows.

blocks.title: Example 1: balance of trade
blocks.statement: A country exports goods worth 350 billion FCFA and imports goods worth 420 billion FCFA. Find the balance of trade.
steps: A negative sign means a deficit.

blocks.title: Example 2: why process locally?
blocks.statement: Why is it better for a country to export chocolate rather than raw cocoa beans?
steps: Finished goods sell at higher prices.
Processing creates local jobs and keeps value in the country.
blocks.answer: It earns more money and creates jobs.

exercises.prompt: Explain two advantages and one disadvantage of regional economic groupings like CEMAC.
exercises.model: Advantages: larger market and easier trade without heavy duties; shared infrastructure and cooperation. Disadvantage: weak transport links and different rules still slow trade, and members may be competing producers.
